text: Mr Lemeri hath thewo, that excrement is not the only matter capable of producing this phofhorous with alumy but that, on the contrary, almost all animal and even vegetable matters are fit for that combinations; that though Mr Hongberg mixed alum in equal quantities only with the local master, it may be used in a much greater part portion, and you in certain cafes, will succeed the better; that, according to the nature of the fulbiances to be worked on, the quantity of that fish may be more or the increacity, and that whatever is indeed, more than the dofe requisite for each matter, ferives only to laffen the virtue of the photohorus, or even deflays it entirely that the degree of fire applied until the different according to the nature of those matters i and, kallly, that falls containing exactly the fame acid with that of alum, or the need of the folks far separated from his balls and reflects inno girls, too mustfer in the protein operation , which thews, fays Mr Lemeri, that many fulphureous matters may yet disbulated the excrement in this operation; but that there are no fails, or very few, if any, that will furced in the place of alum.
